raw: {"verdict": "pass", "reason": "The patch adds a properly labelled Note textarea (maxLength 500), validates the API with zod max(500), which returns 400 on failure, and stores `note?.trim() || null`, so blank notes become NULL and inner line breaks survive. The admin card renders the note as escaped plain text with whitespace-pre-wrap. The one gap is that the 500-character limit is checked before trimming, so a note padded with whitespace could be rejected even if its trimmed length is 500 or less. The issue doesn't clearly require otherwise."}
